purpose: The `sldb docs recover` command: Resolve [[links]] and report their targets.
how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'recover'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
